Thanks for the ping, Olga. Emily — apologies for the hiccup. Quick notes from Finance so we can produce the correct paperwork: 

1) Accounting treatment: Because this was a promotional allowance tied to the pilot (not a product return), we will issue a credit memo and record a contra-revenue entry. That will hit G/L 4005 (Product revenue) with a credit memo contra line to G/L 7002 (Promotions & allowances).

2) Invoice offset vs separate credit memo: We can do either. Per HardGoods’ request to clear month-end, we recommend issuing a standalone credit memo referencing invoice #55321 and then applying it as an offset in the billing system so the net due on the next statement is zero. If you prefer immediate invoice adjustment, we’ll need approval from Accounting Ops to re-issue the invoice as a net amount — that takes an additional 24–48 hours.

3) Tax: For US customers, the credit memo will mirror the invoice tax treatment (taxable amount reduced accordingly). We need confirmation if HardGoods is tax-exempt for this order; otherwise we’ll include the same sales tax line.

4) Required fields / artifacts: please provide PO number (or confirm N/A), billing contact, and the AP remit-to address to list on the credit memo. Also confirm whether HardGoods needs the credit memo as a PDF only or a DocuSign acknowledgement for their records.

I attached two files: credit_memo_template.pdf (our standard form) and gla_mapping.csv (internal mapping lines). I’ll prepare the CM draft once we have the PO and tax exemption status.

Laura — can you schedule this for the next batch today once we have the inputs so it shows up on their statement?

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Manager, Revenue Operations
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
